_about: Compatible-salvage to usable-component workflow (Prompt 08, Part S). Read by ScienceActions. Every donor is an existing damaged object of the map (data/colony_manifest.json). Which parts fit, the clues and the bench-test numbers are made up for the game (illustrative). A salvaged part is turned into one working component: nothing is made from rock, and no matter is created.

donors.name: Old air filter unit
donors.story: A worn-out air filter unit, taken out of the life-support loop and left by the wall.

parts.name: Fan motor
parts.clue: It spins freely and its plug matches the cabin fan sockets.
parts.test: Spins at full speed for ten minutes and stays cool (illustrative test).

parts.name: Blower wheel
parts.clue: No cracks; it is the same size as the cabin fan wheels.
parts.test: Turns smoothly with no wobble (illustrative test).

parts.name: Filter mesh
parts.clue: Clogged with fine dust and torn in two places: it cannot be cleaned.

parts.name: Rubber seal
parts.clue: Hard and cracked: it would leak air.

donors.name: Battery rack with a fault alarm
donors.story: One battery rack in the Power Room has a fault alarm and is switched out of the colony battery.

parts.name: Copper bus bar
parts.clue: Clean copper, no burn marks; the bolt holes match the power panel.
parts.test: Carries the test current with no heating (illustrative test).

parts.name: Switching relay
parts.clue: It clicks on and off when tested with a small battery.
parts.test: Switches on and off 100 times without a miss (illustrative test).

parts.name: Battery cell
parts.clue: Swollen case: a damaged cell is unsafe to use.

parts.name: Alarm circuit board
parts.clue: Scorched around the main chip: it caused the alarm.

donors.name: Burnt switchgear cabinet
donors.story: A switchgear cabinet that overheated. The burnt parts are inside; some others look fine.

parts.name: Switching relay
parts.clue: Not touched by the fire; it clicks when tested.
parts.test: Switches on and off 100 times without a miss (illustrative test).

parts.name: Cable lugs
parts.clue: Shiny metal, the right size for the solar cables.
parts.test: Holds the cable tight under a pull test (illustrative test).

parts.name: Circuit breaker
parts.clue: Melted plastic case: it cannot switch safely any more.

parts.name: Control card
parts.clue: Black with soot and its tracks are broken.

donors.name: Console with a fault alarm
donors.story: An old Command Room console that keeps sounding a fault alarm. Its screen is dead, but its cooling parts look fine.

parts.name: Cooling fan motor
parts.clue: The same model as the cabin fan motors, and it spins freely.
parts.test: Spins at full speed for ten minutes and stays cool (illustrative test).

parts.name: Cable lugs
parts.clue: Clean metal, the right size for the solar cables.
parts.test: Holds the cable tight under a pull test (illustrative test).

parts.name: Display screen
parts.clue: Cracked across the middle: it shows nothing.

parts.name: Keypad
parts.clue: Half the keys are stuck with dust.

donors.name: Crashed lander tank
donors.story: A gas tank thrown clear when the cargo lander crashed. The tank is pierced, but its fittings may still work.

parts.name: Gas valve
parts.clue: It opens and closes smoothly and has the same thread as the colony's oxygen fittings.
parts.test: Holds pressure with no leak for an hour (illustrative test).

parts.name: Pressure gauge
parts.clue: The glass is whole and the needle moves back to zero.
parts.test: Reads the same as the colony's own gauge (illustrative test).

parts.name: Tank liner
parts.clue: Pierced right through by the crash.

parts.name: Mounting strap
parts.clue: Bent and torn at the bolt.

donors.name: Broken-down rover
donors.story: An old rover that broke down out on the plain, tipped on one side with a wheel gone. Its tool locker and some of its parts can still be used.

parts.name: Tool kit
parts.clue: The locker is dusty but sealed: the wrenches and drivers inside are clean and whole.
parts.test: Every tool fits its socket and turns smoothly (illustrative test).

parts.name: Wheel hub motor
parts.clue: It turns by hand without grinding and its plug matches the scout's wheel sockets.
parts.test: Spins both ways at full speed and stays cool (illustrative test).

parts.name: Navigation camera
parts.clue: The lens is scratched but the picture comes through clean.
parts.test: Sends a sharp picture for ten minutes (illustrative test).

parts.name: Cracked wheel
parts.clue: Split right across the rim: it would break on the first rock.

parts.name: Old battery pack
parts.clue: Swollen and leaking: unsafe to use, leave it sealed.

donors.added_by: Prompt 10 (rover economy). Map evidence: a large static wreck at the crash site with charred (sf_char) and gouged (sf_gouge) materials.
donors.name: Crashed rocket stage
donors.story: The upper stage of the cargo lander broke up when it crashed. Its outside is burnt, but some machine parts deep inside were shielded from the fire.

parts.name: Wiring harness
parts.clue: The cables inside the stage wall are not melted, and their plugs are the same kind as the rover's.
parts.test: Every wire carries the test current with no break (illustrative test).

parts.name: Valve actuator motor
parts.clue: A small electric motor behind a metal shield. It still turns smoothly when you spin it by hand.
parts.test: Turns both ways at the test voltage and stays cool (illustrative test).

parts.name: Turntable bearing
parts.clue: It rolls smoothly with no grinding, and its dust seal is whole.
parts.test: Spins for a minute with no noise or wobble (illustrative test).

parts.name: Engine nozzle
parts.clue: Cracked and bent by the crash, and nothing in the colony needs a rocket nozzle.

parts.name: Outer skin panel
parts.clue: Scorched and torn: the crash fire burnt it.

donors.added_by: Prompt 10 (rover economy). Map evidence: the cargo lander's heat shield at the crash site, charred (sf_char) and gouged (sf_gouge).
donors.name: Crashed heat shield
donors.story: The heat shield that protected the cargo lander on the way down. It was thrown clear in the crash and landed on its edge.

parts.name: Titanium mounting bracket
parts.clue: From the back of the shield, away from the heat: straight, no cracks, and its bolt holes match the rover's.
parts.test: Holds the test load without bending (illustrative test).

parts.name: Temperature sensor
parts.clue: Its wires are whole, and it reads the air temperature correctly when tested.
parts.test: Reads the same as the colony thermometer (illustrative test).

parts.name: Heat shield tile
parts.clue: It burnt away on purpose to protect the lander: what is left is charred and crumbly.

parts.name: Honeycomb core
parts.clue: Crushed flat by the impact.

donors.added_by: Prompt 10 (rover economy). Map evidence: a flat field of lander pieces (charred sf_char, torn foil sf_mli) east of the crash site.
donors.name: Crash debris, east side
donors.story: Pieces of the cargo lander lie spread over the ground east of the crash. Most are scrap, but a few were packed cargo.

parts.name: Cargo pallet rollers
parts.clue: Metal rollers from a cargo pallet. They still roll freely and none is bent.
parts.test: Every roller turns under the test load (illustrative test).

parts.name: Insulated cable reel
parts.clue: The insulation has no cuts and the copper ends are clean.
parts.test: Passes the insulation test with no leak of current (illustrative test).

parts.name: Foil insulation blanket
parts.clue: Shiny foil torn into strips: it cannot be patched.

parts.name: Charred panel
parts.clue: Black and brittle from the crash fire.

donors.added_by: Prompt 10 (rover economy). Map evidence: a flat field of lander pieces (charred sf_char, torn foil sf_mli) west of the crash site.
donors.name: Crash debris, west side
donors.story: More pieces of the cargo lander, thrown to the west. A sealed box and a coiled hose are among the scrap.

parts.name: Sealed junction box
parts.clue: Its lid kept the dust out, and the terminals inside are clean and bright.
parts.test: Every terminal connects at the test current (illustrative test).

parts.name: Pressure hose
parts.clue: Both end fittings are whole, and it holds air when you block one end and blow.
parts.test: Holds pressure with no leak for an hour (illustrative test).

parts.name: Aluminium strut
parts.clue: Bent too far to straighten safely.

parts.name: Foil scraps
parts.clue: Torn foil insulation: it is too damaged to use.

donors.added_by: Prompt 10 (rover economy). Map evidence: lander pieces (charred sf_char, torn foil sf_mli) near the heat shield.
donors.name: Crash debris near the heat shield
donors.story: A trail of pieces between the heat shield and the rocket stage. Some came from a spare-parts crate that burst open.

parts.name: Suspension spring
parts.clue: A coil spring that springs back to its full length when you press it.
parts.test: Takes the test load and springs back every time (illustrative test).

parts.name: Sealed box of bolts
parts.clue: The box was sealed. The bolts are clean, and the thread matches the colony's own.
parts.test: Every bolt screws in and holds its tightening force (illustrative test).

parts.name: Melted plastic case
parts.clue: Melted out of shape in the crash fire.

parts.name: Torn foil
parts.clue: Shredded insulation foil.

donors.added_by: Prompt 10 (rover economy). Map evidence: the high-voltage battery unit in the Power Room whose screen shows a fault alarm (scr_red), like pr_bat_rack_alarm.
donors.name: High-voltage battery unit with a fault alarm
donors.story: The control unit of one battery string. Its fault alarm is on and it is switched out of the colony battery. The fault is in its control board.

parts.name: High-voltage contactor
parts.clue: The big switch clicks firmly, and its contacts are not pitted or burnt.
parts.test: Switches the test current on and off 100 times without a miss (illustrative test).

parts.name: Current sensor
parts.clue: It reads the same current as the colony's meter when tested.
parts.test: Reads within the meter's own accuracy at three test currents (illustrative test).

parts.name: Control board
parts.clue: A burnt patch around one chip: this is what set off the alarm.

parts.name: Main fuse
parts.clue: Blown: a fuse is made to break once and must be replaced, not reused.

donors.added_by: Prompt 10 (rover economy). Map evidence: a second Power Room battery rack with a fault alarm (same asset as pr_bat_rack_alarm, screens scr_red and scr_amber).
donors.name: Second battery rack with a fault alarm
donors.story: Another battery rack switched out of the colony battery by its fault alarm. Only some of its modules failed.

parts.name: Healthy battery module
parts.clue: This module is on the side away from the alarm: its case is flat, not swollen, and it shows the right voltage.
parts.test: Charges and gives back its energy at the right voltage (illustrative test).

parts.name: Copper bus bar
parts.clue: Clean copper, no burn marks; the bolt holes match the power panel.
parts.test: Carries the test current with no heating (illustrative test).

parts.name: Swollen battery module
parts.clue: Its case bulges: a swollen battery is unsafe to use.

parts.name: Alarm sensor board
parts.clue: Corroded where a cell leaked onto it.

donors.added_by: Prompt 10 (rover economy). Map evidence: a third Power Room battery rack with a fault alarm (same asset as pr_bat_rack_alarm, screens scr_red and scr_amber).
donors.name: Third battery rack with a fault alarm
donors.story: A third rack the alarm switched out. Its cooling fan and some modules look fine.

parts.name: Healthy battery module
parts.clue: Flat case, clean terminals and the right voltage on the meter.
parts.test: Charges and gives back its energy at the right voltage (illustrative test).

parts.name: Rack cooling fan
parts.clue: It spins freely, and its plug matches the rover's fan socket.
parts.test: Spins at full speed for ten minutes and stays cool (illustrative test).

parts.name: Leaking battery module
parts.clue: Crusty white marks at a seam: it has leaked and is unsafe.

parts.name: Rack display
parts.clue: Cracked screen that shows nothing.

donors.added_by: Prompt 10 (rover economy). Map evidence: the greenhouse grow rack showing a fault (red fault light kit_led_red, amber screen scr_amber).
donors.name: Grow rack with a fault light
donors.story: A greenhouse grow rack that shows a red fault light. Its plants were moved to the beds; the rack's pump seized, but other parts work.

parts.name: LED light driver
parts.clue: It powers a test lamp steadily with no flicker.
parts.test: Runs a test lamp at full brightness for an hour (illustrative test).

parts.name: Water valve
parts.clue: It opens and closes smoothly and has the same thread as the colony's pipes.
parts.test: Holds water pressure with no drip for an hour (illustrative test).

parts.name: Seized pump
parts.clue: Stuck solid with dried nutrient salts: this is the fault.

parts.name: Cracked grow tray
parts.clue: Split along the bottom: it would leak.
